newsitem.title: USA: American Wagering acquires Autotote unit.
newsitem.headline: American Wagering acquires Autotote unit.

text.p: American Wagering Inc said on Wednesday that it acquired Autotote CBS Inc, a unit of Autotote Corp.

American Wagering said it paid $3 million in addition to assumption of certain liabilities. Autotote CBS is a provider of sports and race book equipment and software in the state of Nevada. It had revenues for fiscal 1995 of $5.9 million.
The purchase also included Las Vegas real estate valued at $2.6 million and the assumption of the mortgage of about $2 million.
